style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit Autumn & Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Create the ultimate warm welcome home this autumn and Christmas with the pre lit seasonal garland. </p><p>At 1.5m in length and made with a sturdy, natural twig frame, this premium garland is thick and full, featuring a mixture of faux foliage including red robin and eucalyptus, it will stand the test of time and become a staple in your decor year after year. </p><p>With a warm colour pallet of deep greens, burnt oranges and rich plums, it encapsulates the beauty of the changing seasons. Illuminated by 50 warm white micro lights on discreet green wire, it’ll create a warm glow to seamlessly transition your home from autumn into winter. </p><p>Style it on your staircase or across your mantelpiece for an elegant ambience and pair with the matching wreath to complete the look.</p><p>Simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6 hour timer function for an automatic sparkle at the same time each evening. Size : ONE</p>
